cards.text: The LORD speaks to Moses, Israel's leader, about the Midianites, the people the LORD said had deceived Israel in the matter of Peor (Numbers 25:16-18). He tells Moses, "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites." And He adds that after that, Moses will be gathered to his people.

cards.question: Moses tells the people to arm some of their men to go against the Midianites. Whose vengeance does he say they'll carry out?

cards.text: Moses calls for a thousand men from each tribe of Israel, twelve thousand armed for war. With them goes Phinehas, son of Eleazar the priest, carrying the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

cards.question: The army wages war against Midian just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.text: They kill every male of Midian, including Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also kill Balaam son of Beor with the sword, the man Balak king of Moab once called to curse Israel (Numbers 22:4-6).

cards.question: The Israelites capture the Midianite women and their children. What else do they take from Midian?

answers.text: Their herds and flocks and goods

cards.question: With the people and goods taken, the Israelites ___ all the cities and encampments where the Midianites had lived.
The army leaves the plunder behind and brings only the captives back to Moses.

cards.text: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders go outside the camp on the plains of Moab to meet the army. But Moses is angry with the officers, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds.

cards.question: Moses is angry with the army's officers. What does he ask them?

answers.text: If they spared all the women
Why they killed the five kings
Where Phinehas had gone off to

cards.question: Moses says the women caused the sons of Israel to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor. Through whose counsel does he say it happened?

cards.text: And Moses says that because of it, the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.

This next part is heavy, friend. Moses orders them to kill all the boys and every woman who has had relations with a man, but to spare for themselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.

Then come the rules for getting clean after the battle. Anyone who killed a person or touched the dead stays outside the camp for seven days, and the soldiers, their captives and their things all get purified, some by fire and water and some by water alone. On the seventh day they wash their clothes, and then they may enter the camp.
Then the LORD tells Moses, Eleazar the priest and the family heads to count everything captured, both people and animals.

cards.question: The LORD says to divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD has a share set aside from each half: some for Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD, and some for the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle. Moses and Eleazar do as the LORD commanded, counting out huge numbers of sheep, cattle, donkeys and people and splitting it all into two halves.

Then the commanders of thousands and of hundreds come to Moses. They've counted every soldier under their command, and friend, I can't count the chocolate chips in ONE cookie without starting over THREE times.

cards.question: After counting the soldiers under their command, the commanders report that some of their men are missing.
The commanders bring the LORD an offering of the gold each man acquired. What do they say it's for?

answers.text: To pay for the army's weapons
To thank Moses for leading them

cards.text: Moses and Eleazar receive all the gold articles, and they weigh 16,750 shekels. That's a LOT of gold for a stamper like me, who once sat in a closing bakery's bin with a price sticker that said 25 cents.

cards.question: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself.
Where do Moses and Eleazar bring the commanders' gold, as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD?

answers.text: Up to the top of Mount Nebo
Across to the city of Jericho
